title: The Transfiguration
lead: On a high mountain Jesus was changed before three disciples: his face shone, Moses and Elijah spoke with him, and a voice from a bright cloud called him God's beloved Son. The scene echoes Moses on Sinai and points ahead to the resurrection.

sections.h: The event in the New Testament
sections.b: The first three Gospels tell the story right after Peter's confession and Jesus' first prediction of his death (Matthew 17:1–8; Mark 9:2–8; Luke 9:28–36). Luke adds that Moses and Elijah spoke of his "departure" at Jerusalem. 2 Peter 1:16–18 appeals to it as eyewitness proof of Christ's majesty. The Gospels do not name the mountain; tradition since the 300s names Mount Tabor, and many modern scholars suggest Mount Hermon. Churches keep the feast on 6 August.
